entries.title: Cold Fear

emulation.emulator: Native Windows via GOG; PCSX2 or xemu only for original console copies
emulation.notes: Use the GOG build for normal play. Use PCSX2 or xemu only if you specifically want to compare original PS2 or Xbox versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern Windows PC release with widescreen, high resolution, high refresh, and controller support.

primary.why: The GOG Preservation Program release is the best version because it restores the PC version for modern Windows with native widescreen/high-resolution support up to 4K, high refresh rates, modern controller support, crash fixes, cloud saves, and ongoing preservation maintenance.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Cold Fear on GOG and play the Preservation Program build on a modern Windows PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a restored PC release, not a remake; it preserves the original game while adding compatibility, controller, display, and stability fixes.
